snippet.title: Pink Light - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/pink-light/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4071450/Pink_Light/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

In this action RPG, play as a devoted Sister cursed by a demon and stripped of healing magic. Fight through a deadly dungeon with fast-paced sword combat, various gear choices, and relentless traps. Uncover dark secrets before Yarashina City falls.
